00102 void UGenOutput::useExternalOutput(UGenOutput* externalOutputToUse)
00103 {
00104     if(externalOutputToUse == 0)
00105     {
00106         float value = 0.f;
00107         
00108         if(block)
00109             value = block[blockSize-1];
00110         
00111         usingExternalOutput = false;
00112         blockSize = UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize();
00113         allocatedBlockSize = blockSize;
00114         block = new float[blockSize];
00115         externalOutput = 0;
00116         
00117         initValue(value);
00118     }
00119     else
00120     {
00121         float value = 0.f;
00122         
00123         if(block)
00124             value = block[blockSize-1];
00125         
00126         if(usingExternalOutput == false)
00127             delete [] block;
00128         
00129         usingExternalOutput = true;
00130         block = externalOutputToUse->block;
00131         blockSize = externalOutputToUse->blockSize;
00132         allocatedBlockSize = 0;
00133         externalOutput = externalOutputToUse;
00134         
00135         initValue(value);
00136     }
00137 }

00259 float* UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00260 {
00261     if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00262     {
00263         processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00264         
00265         if(isScheduledForDeletion == false && shouldDelete == true)
00266         {
00267             isScheduledForDeletion = true;
00268             blockIDtoBeDeletedAfter = blockID;
00269         }
00270         
00271         lastBlockID = blockID;
00272     }
00273     
00274     return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00275 }

00321 int UGenInternal::findMaxInputChannels() const throw()
00322 {
00323     int numChannels = 0;
00324     
00325     for(int i = 0; i < numInputs_; i++)
00326     {
00327         int inputChannels = inputs[i].getNumChannels();
00328         if(inputChannels > numChannels)
00329             numChannels = inputChannels;
00330     }
00331     
00332     return numChannels;
00333 }

00354     if(blockSize > 0)
00355     {

00360         return 0.f;

00369 UGenInternal* UGenInternal::getInput(const int inputIndex, const int channel) throw()
00370 {
00371     ugen_assert(channel >= 0);
00372     
00373     if(inputIndex < 0 || inputIndex >= numInputs_) 
00374     {
00375         ugen_assertfalse;
00376         return 0;
00377     }
00378     
00379     UGen& input = inputs[inputIndex];
00380     return input.getInternalUGen(channel % input.getNumChannels());

00424 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::deleteIfOnlyMutualReferencesRemain() throw()
00425 {
00426     if(getRefCount() > numProxies_) return; 
00427     
00428     for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00429     {
00430         if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() > 1) return;
00431     }
00432     
00433     for(int i = 1 ; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00434     {
00435         UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(proxies[i]);
00436     }
00437     
00438     active = false;
00439     UGen::getDeleter()->deleteInternal(this);
00440 }

00442 UGenInternal* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::getProxy(const int index) throw()
00443 {
00444     // indices are between 0 and numProxies_ (0 is the owner)
00445     if(index < 0 || index > numProxies_) 
00446     {
00447         ugen_assertfalse;
00448         return 0;
00449     }
00450     
00451     proxies[index]->incrementRefCount();
00452     return proxies[index];

00455 void ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00456 {
00457     ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00458     
00459     if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00460     {
00461         UGenInternal::prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00462         
00463         for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00464         {
00465             // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00466             // prepared by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00467             if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00468                 proxies[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00469         }   
00470     }
00471 }

00474 float* ProxyOwnerUGenInternal::processBlockInternal(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00475 {
00476     if(blockID != lastBlockID)
00477     {
00478         for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies_; i++)
00479         {
00480             // if the refCount is only 1 its block won't get 
00481             // prepared by the normal dsp call chain, check for <=1 just in case
00482             if(proxies[i]->getRefCount() <= 1)
00483                 proxies[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00484         }
00485 
00486         UGenInternal::processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00487     }
00488     
00489     return uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00490 }
